article_title: Pubs in England and Wales to allow digital ID apps to prove age

tasks.prompt: What change do the new rules introduce for alcohol age checks in England and Wales?
options: Approved phone-based digital ID apps may be accepted as proof of age
Every customer must carry both a passport and a phone
Pubs may stop checking customers' ages
Only the Post Office may verify a customer's age
tasks.correct_answer: Approved phone-based digital ID apps may be accepted as proof of age
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכללים מאפשרים לפאבים ולחנויות לקבל אפליקציות זיהוי דיגיטלי מאושרות כהוכחת גיל, לצד אמצעים קיימים.

tasks.prompt: Which digital ID suppliers are named as examples in the article?
options: Google, Apple and Microsoft
The Post Office, Yoti and Luciditi
UKHospitality, the ABI and Ofcom
Big Brother Watch, Yoti and the NHS
tasks.correct_answer: The Post Office, Yoti and Luciditi
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת את Post Office, ‏Yoti ו־Luciditi כדוגמאות, בתנאי שיופיעו ברשימה ממשלתית מאושרת.

tasks.prompt: What does “technology-agnostic” mean in the government's plan?
options: The plan rejects all age-checking technology
Every app must use one identical technical design
The government will not prescribe exactly how each app must work
Only offline technology will be approved
tasks.correct_answer: The government will not prescribe exactly how each app must work
tasks.explanation_hebrew: technology-agnostic פירושו שהתוכנית אינה מחייבת טכנולוגיה או שיטת מימוש מסוימת לכל האפליקציות.

tasks.prompt: How does Yoti check that the person using the app is its registered owner?
options: It asks the pub to inspect a passport
It sends a letter to the user's home
It checks the user's mobile-data provider
It matches a live face scan with the person who registered
tasks.correct_answer: It matches a live face scan with the person who registered
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הדוגמה, Yoti מאפשרת התחברות רק כאשר סריקת הפנים תואמת לאדם שנרשם לאפליקציה.

tasks.prompt: Why is the QR code generated by the app time-limited?
options: To make copying or sharing it more difficult
To make a customer's phone charge faster
To limit purchases to one drink
To ensure every venue uses a different supplier
tasks.correct_answer: To make copying or sharing it more difficult
tasks.explanation_hebrew: תוקף קצר מקשה להעביר את הקוד לאדם אחר או להשתמש בצילום שלו לאחר זמן.

tasks.prompt: What does UKHospitality mean by saying the roll-out should not be “burdensome”?
options: It should not reveal a customer's age
It should not impose excessive cost or difficulty on businesses
It should replace every physical document immediately
It should be managed only by customers
tasks.correct_answer: It should not impose excessive cost or difficulty on businesses
tasks.explanation_hebrew: burdensome פירושו מכביד; הארגון מבקש שהיישום יהיה יעיל, זול יחסית ועם כמה ספקים לבחירה.

tasks.prompt: Describe the privacy and security features proposed for digital proof of age.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שיתוף מופחת של מידע, סריקה או הקשה, אימות בעל המכשיר וקוד מוגבל בזמן.
expected_points: Customers may share an age result instead of handing over an official document
A phone may be tapped on a reader or show a QR code
Apps must prevent borrowing an older person's device
The app must verify that it belongs to the user
Yoti uses facial matching
The QR code expires to discourage duplication

tasks.prompt: Explain why campaigners want physical ID to remain a reasonable alternative.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר הדרה דיגיטלית, בחירה, פרטיות, אבטחה, מיומנויות ואמצעים.
expected_points: Some people choose physical documents
Some have privacy or security concerns
Some lack digital skills
Some cannot afford or use the necessary device
A digital-only rule could exclude millions
Businesses should not make digital ID effectively mandatory

tasks.prompt: Summarise the intended benefits, technical requirements and concerns surrounding the new digital ID rules.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את המהירות, האבטחה, הספקים, התאימות, עבודה ללא רשת וסכנת ההדרה.
expected_points: Approved apps may speed and secure age checks
Customers can disclose fewer personal details
Apps must verify the user and resist sharing
Different approved apps should work across venues
Services should work without mobile data or Wi-Fi
Businesses may still accept physical ID
Campaigners warn against digital ID becoming mandatory

tasks.prompt: Write a short guidance notice for a pub introducing digital age checks fairly.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח הודעה ברורה באנגלית שמסבירה את האפשרויות, האימות, הפרטיות והחלופה הפיזית.
expected_points: State that approved digital ID is optional
Explain how the QR code or reader works
Mention that only the age result is needed
Offer a reasonable physical-ID alternative
Explain offline availability where supported
Avoid excluding customers without suitable phones or skills
